verdict.rationale: E2B has no built-in natural-language interface; it is driven through the SDK and CLI (e2b-docs-1, e2b-docs-9). Natural-language operation is possible only indirectly: you wire an LLM to the sandbox through tool use (e2b-docs-32), or run a pre-built agent such as Claude Code inside a sandbox (e2b-docs-28, e2b-docs-42), which still requires integration work. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface for managing sandboxes, first-party documentation of NL-driven operation of E2B itself, and hands-on corroboration that it works smoothly.
